hvidb.construction_note: Evaluation positives are restricted to viruses with recoverable sequences in the retrievable gallery, so operational reachability is 100% by construction.

intact_cross_test.construction_note: Gallery = 1,115 sequence-available HVIDB-2104 IDs plus 114 IntAct true-partner viruses outside the nominal set, added so ranking remains defined for every query. Operational reachability is 100%; natural coverage of the HVIDB-2104 nominal universe is reported separately as nominal membership (34.8%).

interpretation: 100% reachability is an operational property of gallery construction/filtering, not empirical retrieval success and not the natural coverage rate of incomplete interaction databases.
